pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Date Picker Dialog grid: table role=grid whose day cells (td) are the focusable gridcells with a roving tabindex. Since 0.3.0: one grid per visible month with a single roving tab stop across all grids, and range selection (aria-multiselectable grids).

roles.role: none; the first month heading is a polite live region

aria.value: Month-year heading id, or the label option; with several months and a label, '{label}, {month}' so each grid has a distinct name
"polite" on the first visible month heading: month changes are announced once
Localized full date (dateStyle full); in a committed range the first and last day add ', start of range', ', end of range', or ', start and end of range'
"true" on the selected day (single mode), on every day of a committed range, or on the pending first day (range mode)
"true" for out-of-range and consumer-disabled days, and, while a first day is pending, for days that would break minDays/maxDays (still focusable)
Full weekday name; the visible text is abbreviated
"true" when the adjacent month is entirely out of range (stays focusable)

keyboard.action: Next / previous day (mirrored in RTL); crosses months and moves between visible grids.
First / last day of the week, respecting firstDayOfWeek.
Same day next / previous month (clamped to the month length); all visible months scroll by one.
Same day next / previous year (29 February clamps to 28).
Select the day (ignored for disabled days).
First pick: set the pending first day (announced politely). Second pick: complete the range in either order and emit aui-change.
Discard the pending first day (otherwise Escape is not handled by the Calendar).
Show the previous / next month; focus stays on the button.
Previous month, next month, then the one tabbable day (one tab stop across all visible months).

focus: Exactly one day is tabbable across all visible months: the focused day (the selected day or range start, else today, clamped to min/max). Focus never moves outside min/max, and with several months the view stops at min and max so no month is entirely disabled. Days show a focus-visible outline in color-focus-ring (drawn inside the cell for days in a range).
notes: Selected and today states are conveyed by aria-selected and aria-current, not by color alone (today also has a ring and bold text).
Disabled days remain focusable so keyboard users can move through them, as the APG recommends.
Outside days (one visible month only) are rendered with muted text and remain selectable; selecting one shows its month.
Range mode: the preview between the pending first day and the hovered or focused day is not a selection (no aria-selected) and is marked by an inner edge in addition to the fill, not by color alone.
Range mode: the pending first day is announced through the shared live region ("{date} selected as the first day. Choose the last day.").
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of the full-date cell names, range day names, column headers, month changes, and the pending first day has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
